name: Coloplast A/S
reason: A leading provider of general wound care dressings (such as Biatain), but does not manufacture negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT) devices.

name: Innovative Therapies Inc.
reason: Acquired and absorbed by Cardinal Health in 2014, and no longer trades or sells products independently under its own name.

name: Medline Industries, Inc.
reason: Medline acts as a distributor for other companies' NPWT lines (such as Smith & Nephew's PICO and Mölnlycke's Avance Solo) rather than owning or manufacturing its own proprietary brand of NPWT devices.

name: DevonMedicalProducts
reason: Exited this market in March 2018 after selling its complete extriCARE NPWT/wound care product line and associated assets to Alleva Medical Co.

name: Otivio AS
reason: Manufactures the FlowOx vascular therapy boot. While it uses cyclical external negative pressure to improve lower extremity perfusion, it is not an NPWT device applied to a sealed wound bed for exudate drainage.
